challenges.name: fix-price-import
challenges.title: Fix the price import that turned unreadable prices into 0 VND
challenges.description: The Cho Xanh supplier import reads SKU;PRICE lines and 'never fails': an unreadable price such as 18.500 becomes 0, broken lines vanish silently and unknown SKUs are added to the catalog. Fix it so that every line is either applied or rejected with a clear reason and its line number, invalid lines change nothing, and a file where more than half of the lines are rejected is not applied at all. The test runner starts from a fixed catalog, prints the import report and the catalog afterwards.

tests.name: The 18.500 line is rejected, the rest applied
tests.expected:
line 1: RAU-01 15000 -> 14000
line 2: rejected (invalid price "18.500")
line 3: THIT-07 185000 -> 189000
applied 2 of 3 lines
catalog: GAO-05=240000, NUOC-MAM=85000, RAU-01=14000, SUA-01=32000, THIT-07=189000, TRUNG-10=30000

tests.name: Unknown SKU and missing price: exactly half rejected is still applied
tests.expected:
line 1: RAU-01 15000 -> 14000
line 2: rejected (unknown sku RAU-99)
line 3: rejected (missing price)
line 4: TRUNG-10 30000 -> 31000
applied 2 of 4 lines
catalog: GAO-05=240000, NUOC-MAM=85000, RAU-01=14000, SUA-01=32000, THIT-07=185000, TRUNG-10=31000

tests.name: A mostly broken file is not applied at all
tests.expected:
line 2: rejected (missing price)
line 3: rejected (invalid price "1.85e5")
line 4: rejected (price out of range: 0)
import aborted: 3 of 4 lines rejected
catalog: GAO-05=240000, NUOC-MAM=85000, RAU-01=15000, SUA-01=32000, THIT-07=185000, TRUNG-10=30000

tests.name: Spaces, signs and the price range
tests.expected:
line 1: RAU-01 15000 -> 14000
line 2: rejected (invalid price "-5000")
line 3: rejected (invalid price "+235000")
line 4: rejected (price out of range: 150000000)
line 5: THIT-07 185000 -> 100000000
line 6: NUOC-MAM 85000 -> 1
applied 3 of 6 lines
catalog: GAO-05=240000, NUOC-MAM=1, RAU-01=14000, SUA-01=32000, THIT-07=100000000, TRUNG-10=30000

tests.name: The same SKU twice in one file
tests.expected:
line 1: RAU-01 15000 -> 14000
line 2: RAU-01 14000 -> 13500
line 3: rejected (invalid price "abc")
applied 2 of 3 lines
catalog: GAO-05=240000, NUOC-MAM=85000, RAU-01=13500, SUA-01=32000, THIT-07=185000, TRUNG-10=30000
